decisions.reason: The Big Block pool target and draw condition do not change the independently defined Small Block trigger or prize rules.
The ticket lifecycle remains defined relative to each block's draw; changing the Big Block pool trigger does not alter the existing eligibility, burn, reset, or carry-forward attributes.
The Big Block pool trigger does not change the manual prize-claim mode.
The Big Block pool trigger does not change the referral-ticket recipient or the numbers of Small and Big Block tickets issued per referral mint.
The Big Block mechanism remains active, so its ticket counter remains required in NFT metadata; the changed pool trigger neither adds nor removes metadata fields.
The Big Block pool trigger does not change the one-ticket allocation to a random existing NFT when no referral code is used.
The pool target change does not alter the rule that secondary royalties fund prize pools without creating tickets.
The Big Block pool target and draw condition do not change the automatic $10 coded-referral commission.
